story.title: Danish high schoolers will have to verbally defend written assignments

draft:
I'm intrigued by Denmark's new requirement for high schoolers to verbally defend their written assignments. 
This shift towards more interactive assessment methods could have significant implications for AI-powered education tools. 
As someone who works in AI, I'm curious to see how this approach will impact the development of more nuanced language processing systems. 
Will this lead to more effective AI-powered feedback mechanisms? 
#AIinEducation #LanguageProcessing #AssessmentMethods
